# Coverage gate (generated by `tests/routing_eval/coverage.py`; never edit by hand)

outcome: evidence too thin: router cannot be evaluated
kept: coding
excluded: browsing, reasoning

Rule: a class is kept with at least 75 percent of its prompts chosen by the selector (not the fallback) AND at least 3 eligible shortlist models; fewer than 2 kept classes records `evidence too thin: router cannot be evaluated`. An excluded class is excluded from scoring only: its prompts stay in the set and run the fallback chain, and nothing else is edited. A class that is not kept is out of every threshold of the evaluation.

Evidence `as_of` 2026-11-11.

| Class | Eligible models | Prompts | Router-chosen | Share | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| browsing | 1: `perplexity/sonar` | 20 | 20 | 100% | EXCLUDED |
| coding | 3: `anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5`, `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5` | 20 | 20 | 100% | KEPT |
| reasoning | 1: `google/gemini-3.8-flash` | 20 | 20 | 100% | EXCLUDED |

**evidence too thin: router cannot be evaluated**: the work stops here for the owner (shrink the classes, source more figures, or hold `routing-v2`); no evaluation spend occurs.
